title: CLMS Land Surface Temperature (LST) Daily Cycle Global 3km 10-daily V3 (COG)
description: Provides a statistical overview of the land surface temperature daily cycle for each 10-day compositing period and every geostationary sensor image pixel. The minimum, median and maximum LST are calculated for each of the 24 hours of the day. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 3 km and cover the period from January 2018 to the present.
